title: Make a place for your project on GitHub
goal: Create an empty GitHub repository for your project

steps.say: Open github.com and sign in. You can make a free account there if you do not have one.
steps.find: the sign in button on github.com

steps.say: Press the plus icon in the top right corner of any GitHub page and choose New repository.
steps.find: the plus icon in the top right corner

steps.say: Type a short name for the project in the Repository name box. Use letters, numbers and dashes.
Choose who can see it. Private means only you (and people you invite); Public means anyone on the internet. If unsure, choose Private.
Press Create repository. GitHub then shows what to do next; follow its steps in Terminal, inside your project folder.
